title: Tamsin and the Choir
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Lior Thackeray, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
